parts.refutation: The sense connections are not the same as the WSBE8518L1000JKA2's. The re-rank compared the WSBE's 7.62 mm with 30341's 7.87 mm as the same 'dimension A'; they are different dimensions. On 30424 the 0.300 in (7.62 mm) is the spacing of the two sense pins, which sit in a 4-position header (positions 1 and 4), 8.13 mm ref high. On 30341 the 0.310 in (7.87 mm) is the height of the sense pins, and the pin spacing is dimension B = 0.495 in (12.57 mm) for 100 uOhm, two single pins. A sense lead terminated in a housing for the WSBE's pins does not fit the WSBS8518...20. The bolt mounting matches (85 x 18 x 3 mm, 7 mm holes at 60 mm), and the part fits the same connections only if each sense lead ends in a separate contact per pin
